oneLiner: Transform rough status bullets into polished updates—automatically generate executive and team versions.
problem: Team leads waste time rewriting status updates in different voices and detail levels for different audiences, leading to inconsistent messaging or context loss.
targetUser: Engineering managers, product managers, and team leads who report to both executives and individual contributors.
coreFlow: Paste rough status bullets into editor
AI analyzes and segments content by audience relevance
System generates team version (detailed, context-rich, action-oriented)
User reviews, edits, and approves both versions

screens.name: Input Editor
screens.purpose: Paste raw status bullets and optional context (project name, dates, priorities)

screens.name: Dual Preview
screens.purpose: Side-by-side view of executive and team versions with real-time generation

screens.name: Edit & Refine
screens.purpose: Tone sliders and manual editing controls for each version independently

screens.name: Export
screens.purpose: Copy, download, or send versions to email/Slack

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Save and retrieve past status updates for reuse or reference

outOfScope: Team collaboration or commenting on drafts
Analytics on update performance or engagement
